question: How does a shingles vaccine made of a single viral protein beat the live-virus vaccine in people over 70?
answer: Through its adjuvant. Shingrix pairs one protein, glycoprotein E, with AS01, which combines a detoxified fragment of bacterial membrane and QS-21, a saponin from the bark of a Chilean soapbark tree. It rouses ageing T cells. In trials it cut shingles by about 90% in people over 70; the live vaccine had managed about 38%.
move: The helper added to a message can matter more than the message.
ask: What helper or context around a message of mine matters more than the message itself?
reference: Cunningham et al., Efficacy of the herpes zoster subunit vaccine in adults 70 years of age or older, New England Journal of Medicine, 2016
